rows.en: Heh. Just not my style.
That's it for today. Dismissed.
You were so slow, I went ahead and did it for you.
Well then, let's head home.
That was pretty thrilling, huh?
Over already? I'm not satisfied yet.
Luck's part of skill, you know.
Pretty good skills for a woman.
Hey, miss, how about a drink after this?
Whoo! Nice! I'm about to lose to you!
We can still fit in dinner if we go now. Wanna go?
I'd like you to keep flying with me from now on.
No part left for me, huh? Not bad.
Aw, crap!
Let's wrap this up fast.
Don't underestimate the Dalnesian High duo!
rows.notes: School name heard as 'Darunesian'; spelling unverified, not in glossary.

rows.en: Guld, time we settled this.
You've gotten good.
Is that all? You piece of junk!
Guld.
What?
Heh. You're a persistent bastard, always sticking on my tail.
I don't have time to mess around with you!
You keep getting in my way!
rows.notes: Transcript 'jama wa kashiyagatte'; read as 'jama bakkashiyagatte'.

rows.en: Too bad!
rows.notes: Very short and Whisper flagged low confidence.

rows.en: You've been tagging along behind me since we were kids!
rows.notes: Transcript 'gaki nokoru kara'; read as 'gaki no koro kara' (since childhood).

rows.en: I'm just gonna go chase some skirt!
I was winning that New Year's sunrise chicken run too, till you started whining!
rows.notes: 'chikin resu' read as chicken race; 'hatsuhinode' read as New Year's first sunrise.

rows.en: You're the one who still hasn't returned my Guts CD!
rows.notes: 'Guts no CDV' read as a CD named Guts; unsure what 'Guts' refers to.

rows.en: I bought you lunch twice back in high school!
rows.notes: '2 kai' (2nd floor) read as nikai = twice.

rows.en: Quit keeping such careful count!
Like I care!
rows.notes: Transcript 'shiruka'; read as 'shiru ka' (like I know/care).

rows.en: What did you say?!
Shut up!
Damn right.
Don't get so serious. We used to play with human-powered planes as kids, remember? Kill the engine and ride the wind.
Call it my special: Dragon Bird Flight!
Back in middle school, I wrecked that plane you built.
It was so well made, I took it for a little test ride.
Let's forget about the past.
Sorry.
What?!
Hmph, we finally meet!
rows.notes: Speaker is Isamu but the target depends on mission (Sharon or Guld), so kept neutral.

rows.en: Guld! That's my date! Hands off!
Myung... Myung.
rows.notes: Transcript 'Myun Mya'; read as Myung called twice.

rows.en: What did you do? What happened to the people?
Girls!
rows.notes: Transcript 'gaaru-domo' (you girls); could be a mishearing of Guld. Next line addresses several people.

rows.en: Geez, the lot of you! Don't come crying to me later!
Myung.
Tch! So you showed up!
Shut up! I don't wanna hear your weird song!
Ugh... S-stop...
It's not your song I want to hear!
Shut up!
Yeah!
Meow!
Meow.
Feels like I've been having some weird dream.
But I got woken up. By your song.
Still a lousy singer, as always.
I heard it.
Guld, huh? Doing great. I found Myung, too.
Hey!
Ahh, nice!
Guld!
Why do I have to do this?
I'm the one supporting you, so do it right!
I'll share your dream with you.
You'd better be able to handle at least this much.
Oh, fine. I'll produce you myself.
Move the way I plan and you won't have any problems.
You've got no choice but to do it.
Grab your dream with your own strength.
Do it the way you think best.
You'll die if you keep that up!
You make me worry, then do what you like!
Fine, just sit there and hurt, then.
I can't believe it! You let yourself get hit!
Someone help them! Somebody!
Honestly! That's what you get for being reckless!
